name: Rebbec
title: Architect of Ascension
summary: A celebrated Thran architect whose final choice separated Dominaria from Yawgmoth’s Phyrexia.
biography: Rebbec was one of the greatest architects of the ancient Thran civilization. She incorporated powerstones into extraordinary structures, including the floating Thran Temple above Halcyon.
When her husband Glacian fell ill, Rebbec helped bring the physician Yawgmoth to Halcyon. His growing influence contributed to the destruction of the civilization she had helped build.
Recognizing the threat posed by Phyrexia, Rebbec sealed the gateway between the planes, cutting off Yawgmoth’s immediate path back to Dominaria.

featuredCard.name: Rebbec, Architect of Ascension
featuredCard.significance: Depicts the influential Thran architect whose choices shaped Dominaria’s ancient history.
